body:
A reader writes:

 I just read A New Kind of Christianity in 48 hours.

I literally cried early in the book as I felt a huge burden of confusion and decades long, nagging uncertainty lift from my heart. Of course, then by the time I got to the end of you life changing book, my head was spinning with question after question, mixed with excited curiosity to learn more. I think that means more of your books, and others like yours first, then when I feel I grasp your logic better, I will work with my pastor … to very gently introduce the concepts you have outlined.

 Thank you from the bottom of my heart. I am so happy to have found your inspirational, logical and immensely thought provoking work.

 I’m so glad you found the book helpful. Your enthusiasm greatly encourages me!
